## Repair (`source/cclib/parser/orcaparser.py`, only file changed)

Added a handler in `ORCA.extract()` for the dispersion summary line (token-anchored on the `Dispersion correction` prefix plus its numeric value, so it tolerates layout/version variation without matching the surrounding banner text):

- If no dispersion line is present, nothing is touched — ordinary calculations are bit-identical to before.
